about: Martensville is a city in Saskatchewan just north of Saskatoon on Highway 12, one of the province’s fastest-growing suburban communities. Family neighbourhoods, new commercial strips, and a bedroom-community role for Saskatoon define the city. About 10,000 people live in Martensville.
seoSummary: Fast-growing Saskatchewan city north of Saskatoon on Highway 12—suburban family community and Saskatoon bedroom city.
knownFor: Family neighbourhoods and new commercial growth
